upstream.evidence_role: behavioral research only; no upstream implementation is redistributed

upstream_evidence_only.source: Recovered upstream binary/runtime evidence retained for provenance

architecture_deviation.production_behavior: Bex's implementation runs bundled Node 24 directly as a normal child and keeps MCP stdio, private control IPC, and stderr capture separate.
architecture_deviation.must_not: Upstream sandbox markers or metadata MUST NOT drive production launch, kernel reset, or control-channel policy. Bex removed sandbox execution and sandbox state behavior.

initialize.response_protocol_version: the selected version from the supported intersection
initialize.instructions: Use `js` to run JavaScript in the persistent Node-backed kernel. When a skill or prompt says to use `node_repl`, call this server's `js` execution tool. Calls default to a 30000 ms (30 seconds) timeout when `timeout_ms` is omitted. The runtime exposes `nodeRepl.cwd`, `nodeRepl.homeDir`, `nodeRepl.tmpDir`, `nodeRepl.requestMeta`, `nodeRepl.setResponseMeta(...)`, and `await nodeRepl.emitImage(...)`. Top-level bindings persist across `js` calls until `js_reset`; do not redeclare existing `const` or `let` names. Reuse existing bindings, use top-level `var` for reusable state that may be assigned again, or choose a fresh descriptive name. Use `js_add_node_module_dir` before `js` when a skill provides an extra package directory, and use dynamic imports like `await import("playwright")` rather than filesystem paths under `./node_modules`.

request_shape.name: one of the three tool names
request_shape.arguments: object validated by the selected tool inputSchema

success_shape._meta: present only when response metadata was set

error_shape.content: ordered text content describing the failure

kernel.launch: host directly spawns the bundled Node 24 runtime as a normal isolated child
kernel.host_control: host owns MCP stdio and uses the child's private stdin/stdout or ordinary private IPC for kernel control
kernel.execution_model: fresh ESM cell per js call with top-level await
kernel.state: the last successfully linked/committed namespace is carried into the next cell
kernel.failure_commit: prior bindings survive; bindings whose initialization committed before a later throw may survive
kernel.stdout: reserved for private JSONL kernel control; model process is not exposed
kernel.reset: kill/recreate the kernel and clear bindings; configured module search roots survive

module_loader.environment_root: NODE_REPL_NODE_MODULE_DIRS, split by the platform path delimiter
module_loader.trusted_package_cache: trusted package entrypoints retain singleton identity
module_loader.process_import: model code cannot import process or node:process
module_loader.trusted_process: trusted modules receive a frozen metadata-only process facade

node_repl.response_meta: plain-object validation followed by shallow merge
node_repl.background_operations: tracked operations drain before success; unobserved rejection fails the call

native_pipe.legacy_fallback: observed in current codex-desktop integration, not part of the replacement target

lifecycle.timeout_error_marker: js execution timed out; kernel reset, rerun your request
